notes.title: Mystery Drop
notes.content:
The Countdown Begins…
Something is shifting in the world of Climb and Cry. The air is heavier. The walls feel steeper. The silence before the storm is here — and it only lasts 2 more days.

We’re not just talking new routes or skins…
This is bigger.
Mystery. Power. Chaos. A new force is coming.

Mark your calendars. Clear your schedules.
Because in 2 days, everything changes.

Are you ready to climb through the unknown?

🔸 Stay alert. Watch the shadows. 🔸

notes.title: Singleplayer Hotfix#1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225202/8731697ba2efb408f389cdf90d50005cc7120edc.png
-Single player difficulty slightly nerfed to ensure a fun and less punishing climb for hardcore players as well as casual players.
-New Mouse sensitivity slider visible in the pause menu can help everyone to enjoy more.
-Cinematics are now skippable.
-Slight performance upgrade.
